flags.message: gemini-baseline's prediction.json carries created_at 2026-09-30T19:20:00Z, about 95 minutes before its own retrieval_log.json shows the first tool call (20:55Z) and the write-out (20:56Z). The stamp appears to have been copied from the run id rather than read from the clock. It did not affect grading on this forward cell, but a created_at that precedes the cell's work would mislead any timing-based leakage or latency reading that trusts it.
